scope: 5 hand-selected arXiv PDFs; local pilot, not representative accuracy benchmark

generation_mode: fresh production main pipeline including API decomposition, global reranking, evidence ledger, generation and citation checking

english_control.purpose: English translations after the Chinese pilot, same Gold and budgets, no answer keywords inserted and no generation API calls. Diagnostic development control, not an independent test set.
english_control.path_fix: Only provenance path normalization changed between Chinese and successful English runs; Chinese original results retained.
